name: Downpour
description: Rain in thin streaks, each bright at its head and fading up its tail, slanting with the gusts so the shower leans one way and then another.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --a: @rn(-30, 30, 1.1); --l: @rn(0.55, 1.25, 2); -webkit-transform: rotate($deg(a + 16)); transform: rotate($deg(a + 16)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 24%; top: -40%; width: 8%; height: 120%; border-radius: 99px; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, #000 85%); mask: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, #000 85%); -webkit-transform-origin: 50% 100%; transform-origin: 50% 100%; -webkit-transform: scaleY($(l)); transform: scaleY($(l)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 66%; top: -10%; width: 8%; height: 100%; border-radius: 99px; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, #000 85%); mask: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, #000 85%); -webkit-transform-origin: 50% 100%; transform-origin: 50% 100%; -webkit-transform: scaleY($(l)); transform: scaleY($(l)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
